description: This file implements core request processing logic for a proxy server handling language model API requests. It includes functions for parsing streaming data, creating streaming responses with error handling, managing request headers, and processing streaming chunks with optional cost injection. It defines a class ProxyBaseLLMRequestProcessing that encapsulates the main request workflow, including pre-call and post-call hooks, routing requests, and error handling, supporting both streaming and non-streaming modes.
